At most one assignment reassembles the original photograph with all roads and field boundaries continuous across the seams. Which one?
(A) figures [2, 1; 4, 3]
(B) figures [2, 1; 3, 4]
(C) figures [4, 1; 3, 2]
(D) None of the assignments reassembles the photograph correctly.

Answer with only the correct option letter.
